chord.title: Bottom chord (part of the edge piece)
rows: nothing drilled; the post plates are welded on top

stringer.title: Stringer (part of the edge piece)
rows: the seat, 1/2 in above the stub
must stay smooth: no plates or bolt heads on top

seat.title: Seat (part of the edge piece)
rows: lifts the stringer so the impact driver fits under it
3 sides to the stub, 2 sides to the stringer

stub.title: Stub (part of the edge piece)
rows: 2 x 5/16 in through both walls, 1/2 in and 2 in from the stringer end

post.title: Post
rows: 2 x 5/16 in through both walls, 15/16 in and 1 15/16 in from the end
1 x 5/16 in, 15/16 in from the end, through the other two walls (turned 90 degrees)

floor beam.title: Floor beam
rows: none in the tube (bolts go through the plates and the stub)

post plate.title: Post plate (welded on the edge piece)
rows: 2 x 5/16 in, 1/2 in from the outside edge, 1 1/8 in and 2 1/8 in up from the bottom
bottom edge to the chord top, both faces

floor beam plate.title: Floor beam plate (welded on the floor beam)
rows: 2 x 5/16 in, 1/2 in and 2 in from the end that laps the stub, centered
top edge, bottom edge and the end

bolt.title: Bolt
rows: 1/4 in Grade 8 hex bolt, one nut

jig post.title: Short piece of post tube (shop only, comes off)
rows: 1 1/4 x 1 1/4 x 0.065 in tube, about 4 in
bolt the post plates to it while welding; reuse

jig stub.title: Short piece of stub tube (shop only, comes off)
rows: 1 1/4 x 1 1/4 x 0.065 in tube, about 3 3/8 in
bolt the floor beam plates to it while welding; reuse
